failure_clusters.name: Delivery Delay vs Missing Delivered Package Confusion
failure_clusters.description: Customer queries reporting delayed shipping or tracking questions misclassified as lost/missing delivered packages due to aggressive lexical triggers ('not received', 'missing').

failure_clusters.name: Order Cancellation Masked by Secondary Entity Mentions
failure_clusters.description: Inquiries seeking order or subscription cancellation where customer mentions 'prime' or 'refund', causing entity keyword boosts to eclipse the core cancellation intent.

failure_clusters.name: Compound Multi-Intent Customer Requests
failure_clusters.description: Customer messages expressing two valid intents simultaneously (e.g. late delivery + subscription complaint), resulting in single-intent misclassification.

failure_clusters.name: Sparse and Ambiguous Input Deflection
failure_clusters.description: Short messages (< 25 characters) or vague complaints lacking explicit entities, causing over-confident pseudo-random intent classification.

recommendations.title: Strict Guardrails Against Unsupported Operational Commitments
recommendations.problem: Potential customer misinformation if generation templates promise refunds or direct order modifications.
recommendations.evidence: Policy check compliance must remain at 100.00% without regression.
recommendations.proposed_solution: Maintain deterministic zero-tolerance regex guards blocking words like 'I have refunded' or 'I have cancelled' before emission.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Guarantees zero operational liability and prevents customer misinformation.
recommendations.risk: Minimal risk of false positive blocking on valid conversational turns.

recommendations.title: Disambiguate Delivery Delay vs Missing Delivered Package
recommendations.problem: 7 instances of tracking/delivery delay inquiries were misclassified as lost packages, recommending irrelevant mailroom searches.
recommendations.evidence: Cluster A accounts for 3 confusion errors; high-confidence error rate is elevated.
recommendations.proposed_solution: Require explicit confirmation of 'marked as delivered' status before firing the 4.5 missing package boost; let delivery_delay handle transit inquiries.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Immediate +2.0% to +3.5% intent accuracy improvement on hard delivery inquiries.
recommendations.risk: May slightly reduce recall for missing package if user says 'not received' without mentioning delivery status.

recommendations.title: Disambiguate Action Verbs over Substantive Entities in Order Cancellation
recommendations.problem: 10 order cancellation inquiries were misclassified as Prime Membership or Returns/Refunds due to entity keyword dominance.
recommendations.evidence: Order cancellation has the lowest recall (44.44%) of all intents in the benchmark.
recommendations.proposed_solution: Introduce compound precedence rules giving 'cancel' + 'subscription/order' higher priority than bare 'prime' mentions.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Substantial recovery of order_cancellation recall from 44.44% to > 70.00%.
recommendations.risk: Could misclassify general Prime queries that mention 'how do I cancel if I don't like it' as cancellations.

recommendations.title: Calibrated Confidence Thresholding for Short/Ambiguous Inquiries
recommendations.problem: Short (< 25 chars) or ambiguous inquiries receive high confidence predictions (~0.90) due to single word token matches.
recommendations.proposed_solution: Penalize confidence on inputs with token length < 5, routing them to 'unknown_or_ambiguous' clarification.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Reduces high-confidence error rate and improves expected calibration error (ECE).
recommendations.risk: May increase deflection rate on short but legitimate queries.

recommendations.title: Response Template Guidance Polish for Multi-Part Inquiries
recommendations.problem: Guidance adherence drops on compound queries when only the primary issue is addressed.
recommendations.evidence: 10% of examples miss one or more guidance criteria on multi-turn context.
recommendations.proposed_solution: Append modular guidance snippets when secondary intents are detected.
recommendations.risk: Responses may become slightly more verbose.
